transformation:
Suggest a transformation for this request: {prompt}
Return only a JSON object with text (a short explanation) and operations (a list). Supported operations: select with columns (names or expressions); filter with predicate; sort with columns and descending (boolean); drop with columns; with_columns with expressions; head or tail with count; rename with mapping. An expression is an object with op and args. Supported expression ops: col(name), lit(value), all(), add/sub/mul/div/floordiv/mod/eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge/and/or/xor(left,right), neg/pos/not(expression), alias(expression,name), cast(expression,dtype), fill_null/fill_nan(expression,value), round(expression,decimals), is_in(expression,literal_list), is_null/is_not_null/is_nan/is_not_nan/is_finite/abs/sum/mean/min/max/count/n_unique/first/last(expression). Scalars in expression arguments mean literals. Example: {"text":"Top 5 by revenue","operations":[{"op":"sort","columns":["revenue"],"descending":true},{"op":"head","count":5}]}. Never generate Python, callbacks, imports, or file/network operations.
ping: Return a short OK message like 'pong' in plain text.
